name: carbone
label: Carbone
description: Generate documents (PDF, DOCX, XLSX, ODS, and more) from templates and JSON data using the Carbone report generator.

token.label: API Key
token.description:
To get your Carbone API key:
1. Log in to your [Carbone account](https://account.carbone.io/)
2. Navigate to **API keys** in your account settings.
3. Create or copy your API key.

carbone_delete_template.label: Delete Template
carbone_delete_template.description: Delete a Carbone template by its ID.

carbone_update_template.label: Update Template Metadata
carbone_update_template.description: Update the metadata of an existing Carbone template.

tags.label: Tags (optional)
tags.description: Replace tags with a new list.

deployedAt.label: Deployed At (optional)
deployedAt.description: UTC Unix timestamp for when this version should be considered deployed. Values >= 42000000000 (year 3300) = "NOW". Used to determine active version.

expireAt.label: Expire At (optional)
expireAt.description: UTC Unix timestamp for when to delete the template. Values >= 42000000000 (year 3300) = "now". This effectively schedules deletion.

carbone_list_templates.label: List Templates
carbone_list_templates.description: Retrieve a list of deployed Carbone templates with filtering and pagination.

id.label: Template ID Filter (optional)
id.description: Filter by specific Template ID (64-bit format). Exact match.

versionId.label: Version ID Filter (optional)
versionId.description: Filter by specific Version ID (SHA256 format). Exact match.

search.label: Search (optional)
search.description: Fuzzy search in template name, or exact match for ID/Version ID.

includeVersions.label: Include All Versions
includeVersions.description: If checked, returns all versions for a specific template ID (when ID filter is provided).

limit.label: Limit (optional)
limit.description: Maximum number of templates to return. Default is 100.

cursor.label: Cursor (optional)
cursor.description: Pagination cursor for fetching the next set of results.

carbone_list_categories.label: List Categories
carbone_list_categories.description: List all categories used to organize your Carbone templates.

carbone_list_tags.label: List Tags
carbone_list_tags.description: List all tags used to organize your Carbone templates.
